subject: HelioPay post-call: streaming evaluation — technical confirmation & next steps
messages:
From: Connor O’Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@heliopay.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.g@heliopay.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T15:08:00-08:00
Subject: Quick recap + technical asks from today

Hi Priya — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a couple of follow-ups so we can scope the streaming POC properly.

Call recap (high-level):
- Your goal: live payouts chat and real-time reconciliation prompts in merchant support console. Low-latency partial outputs are important for UX.
- Main constraints: 95th percentile latency target ~180ms per token at our expected QPS (burst to 70 r/s) and strict stop-sequence handling to avoid truncated instructions being shown to merchants.

Technical asks / next steps from our side:
1) Can you send a 48-hour sample of production traffic or representative transcripts (redact PII) so we can reproduce partial-output patterns? Prefer .txt logs — sample attached shows the format we need.
2) Please confirm acceptable SLA ranges for: latency (p95), token drop tolerances (how many partial tokens acceptable), and allowed model fallback tiers.
3) We'll run two streaming-focused evals: coherence under partial outputs and stop-sequence robustness. We plan to test: redwood-nova-streaming-1 (quality-first), redwood-lowlatency-1 (latency-optimized), and a quantized L2 variant for cost validation.

Attachments: streaming-sample-logs.txt (format), prompt-set-v1.jsonl (initial prompts we propose for the eval), benchmark-summary-20261118.pdf (current performance baselines).

Proposed timeline:
- 11/17: We start replay/eval once we have sample logs + SLA confirmation
- 11/19: Short sync (30m) to review initial regression signals and choose candidate model for POC

Do you want us to run a quick live demo of the streaming UX on Wednesday afternoon? If so, what time zone works best for you (we're PT).

Thanks — looking forward.

-- 
Connor O’Brien
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0118

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@heliopay.com>
To: Connor O’Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.g@heliopay.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + technical asks from today

Connor — thanks for the clear summary. Couple quick clarifications from our side: 

1) We can share 72 hours of anonymized transcript logs (merchant IDs hashed). Sending via secure SFTP today; expect link by EOD.
2) SLA targets: p95 token latency target 180ms, p99 < 400ms. For partial tokens: anything that results in an incoherent sentence or mid-token cutoff that changes intent is unacceptable. Wed like models to honor explicit stop sequences that our platform inserts ("\u003cEND\u003e", "\u003cUSER_DONE\u003e").
3) Fallback policy: if latency exceeds p95 target for 3 consecutive minutes, auto-fallback to a smaller model is allowed but must be labeled in the UI and have a manual override.

Well accept the demo on 11/19 at 11:00 AM PT. Samir will join and hell share the SFTP link when its up.

One more ask: can you include in your eval an automated check for partial-output coherence (e.g., BLEU/ROUGE-like metric on prefix completions) and a per-prompt stop-sequence hit-rate report? That would help us quantify regressions.

Thanks,
Priya
Sr. Product Manager, HelioPay

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O’Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick recap + technical asks from today (proposed eval plan)

Connor / Vanessa — forwarding Priya's confirmations. Below are the concrete eval steps Im proposing from an applied ML perspective. This is the technical checklist I will run before the 11/19 sync.

=== Eval plan (coherence + stop-sequence focus) ===
1) Data prep: ingest HelioPay anonymized transcripts into the streaming-replay harness. Map merchant prompts to the prompt-set-v1.jsonl attached to the original thread.
2) Models to benchmark (streaming mode):
   - redwood-nova-streaming-1 (baseline quality; expected p95 token latency ~220ms on our standard nodes)
   - redwood-lowlatency-1 (latency-optimized; expected p95 ~140ms)
   - redwood-quant-l2-1 (8-bit quantization candidate; lower cost, check coherence degradation)
3) Metrics we will compute:
   - Streaming coherence score: prefix-F1 (custom) + human spot-checks on 100 samples
   - Stop-sequence hit rate: percentage of responses that respect explicit stop tokens placed in-stream
   - Partial-output truncation count: occurrences where the model emitted a syntactically broken sentence before a stop token
   - Latency distribution: p50/p95/p99 per token and end-to-end response time for 1st stable chunk
4) Automation rules: mark any model that has stop-sequence hit rate < 99% as fail for production; flag models with coherence score drop > 6 pts vs baseline for manual review.
5) Observability artifacts we will produce: per-prompt trace links, KV-cache hit rates, streaming chunk sizes, and small repro snippets for each failure. Attachments will include the prompt set we send to Priya for review.

Notes on stop sequences: several models (esp. quantized variants) sometimes struggle with explicit short stop tokens if the tokenization splits them across byte boundaries. Well run tokenization alignment checks and, if needed, suggest a two-token safe-stop pattern to HelioPay (e.g., "\u003cUSER_DONE\u003e\u003cSTOP\u003e").

Cost/throughput tradeoffs: I expect the quantized candidate to reduce inference cost by ~38% but we should watch for latency tail regressions under burst (we'll simulate 70 r/s).

Deliverables by 11/19 sync:
- Benchmark summary PDF (short) + CSV of per-prompt metrics
- 10 prioritized failure repros with suggested mitigations
- Recommendation: model candidate for a 2-week POC with Redwood Dedicated or hosted fallback profile

--
Marissa Cole
Applied ML, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Connor O’Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@heliopay.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.g@heliopay.com>

Date: 2026-11-19T09:24:00-08:00
Subject: Re: HelioPay post-call: streaming evaluation — 11/19 demo & MAP

Priya / Samir — great, thanks for the SFTP link (received). We kicked the replay off this morning. Quick logistics for the 11/19 11:00 AM PT demo:

Agenda (30m):
- 5m: goal alignment and acceptance criteria (Priya)
- 10m: live streaming demo of two models (lowlatency vs quant candidate) with HelioPay test prompts
- 10m: review early metric snapshots (stop-sequence hit rate, p95 token latency, partial-output examples)
- 5m: agree mutual action plan (POC scope, DRI, timelines)

Mutual action plan (proposed):
- Week 0 (now - 11/19): Redwood runs streaming replay and posts initial benchmarks. HelioPay confirms acceptance criteria + UI labeling requirements.
- Week 1 (11/22 - 11/28): POC rollout on 1% production traffic behind feature flags; real-time observability enabled.
- Week 3: decision gate (expand, tune, or rollback).

DRIs: HelioPay DRI: Samir Gupta; Redwood DRI: Marissa Cole (technical) + me (commercial).

For the demo we will surface the following artifacts (shared Drive link shortly): benchmark-summary-20261118.pdf, prompt-set-v1.jsonl, and a short repro pack with 10 failing snippets. Also attaching a short checklist for HelioPay prodops to enable streaming traces on their side (minimal changes).

If you want us to try the safe two-token stop pattern before the demo I can ask Marissa to include a run with that change; we can show side-by-side.

See you Wednesday at 11:00 AM PT.

--
